goal: Source selects its single-language fast OCR and DPI; scanned PDF reaches final CrawlResult
failure_boundaries: Any source omits explicit OCR language/DPI or belongs to the wrong language group
Traditional Chinese or English isolated complete Source cannot load
Real scanned input contains native text and silently avoids OCR
Effective runtime metadata does not match Source OCR settings
Actual local traineddata bytes differ from tessdata_fast pinned model
Final CrawlResult drops PDF page, OCR text, cleaned HTML or Markdown
Cross-language reuse leaks settings between sequential Sources
scope: No DB, S3, network fetching, production services, OCR quality score or all-source live crawl
